mapper.select: /* TbmAi01Mapper.selectAnalyzeTargets */ SELECT A.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS mtrlItemType , A.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM A INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON (A.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD AND A.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD) /* 테넌트 격리: MTRL_CD 는 회사별 채번이라 전역 유일하지 않다. 항목 자신의 CMPNY_CD 로 함께 좁힌다. */ WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.AI_ANALYZE_YN = 'Y' /* ★v4 추가: 체크된 항목만 분석 */ AND A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE IN ('01','04') /* 확정/분석중 항목은 초기 큐잉에서 제외(확정 보존·중복분석 방지). 재분석은 reanalyze EP */ AND (A.AI_STATUS IS NULL OR A.AI_STATUS IN ('NONE','FAILED','DRAFT')) ORDER BY A.SORT_IDX

/* TbmAi01Mapper.selectAutoAnalyzeTargets */ SELECT A.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS mtrlItemType , A.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM A INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON (A.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD AND A.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD) /* 테넌트 격리: 항목 자신의 CMPNY_CD 로 함께 좁힌다(MTRL_CD 는 회사별 채번). */ WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.AI_ANALYZE_YN = 'Y' AND A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE IN ('01','04') AND (A.AI_STATUS IS NULL OR A.AI_STATUS IN ('NONE','FAILED')) ORDER BY A.SORT_IDX

/* TbmAi01Mapper.selectItemAiRow */ SELECT A.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , A.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS mtrlItemType , A.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , A.AI_ANALYZE_YN AS aiAnalyzeYn , A.AI_STATUS AS aiStatus , A.AI_CONFIRM_DESC AS aiConfirmDesc , A.AI_DRAFT_TEXT AS aiDraftText , A.AI_CHAT_JSON AS aiChatJson , DATE_FORMAT(A.AI_ANALYZED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS aiAnalyzedAt , M.SITE_CD AS siteCd FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM A INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON (A.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD AND A.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD) /* 테넌트 격리: 항목 자신의 CMPNY_CD 로 좁힌다(MTRL_ITEM_CD 는 회사별 채번). */ WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.MTRL_ITEM_CD = #{mtrlItemCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* TbmAi01Mapper.selectItemStatuses */ SELECT A.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS mtrlItemType , A.AI_ANALYZE_YN AS aiAnalyzeYn , A.AI_STATUS AS aiStatus , A.AI_DRAFT_TEXT AS aiDraftText , A.AI_CONFIRM_DESC AS aiConfirmDesc , A.AI_CHAT_JSON AS aiChatJson , DATE_FORMAT(A.AI_ANALYZED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS aiAnalyzedAt FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM A INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON (A.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD AND A.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD) /* 테넌트 격리: 항목 자신의 CMPNY_CD 로 함께 좁힌다(MTRL_CD 는 회사별 채번). */ WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SORT_IDX

/* TbmAi01Mapper.countAnalysisWorklist */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM A INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M
ON (A.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD AND A.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD)
